!For petitioner :Mr.B.Naga Subramanian  (Party-in-person)
^For Respondents :Mr.A.Muthukaruppan  Addl. Govt. Pleader  :ORDER
The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking a direction to the respondents 3 to 5 to grant necessary sanction for prosecution, under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. According to the petitioner, he is working as a Food Safety Officer, Ambasamudram, Tirunelveli District and on inspection, he seized many food samples under the Act and sent it for analyst for analysis.
After receipt of report from the analysis, he sought for sanction from the third respondent/Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai-6, for initiating prosecution.

entities.text: Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai-6
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: According to the petitioner, even though the third respondent/Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai-6 granted sanction, he omitted to include important penal provisions in the Sanction Order.

entities.text: Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai-6
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
3.The grievance of the petitioner is that even as per the analyst report and inspection report filed by him, there are many violations under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, for which he requires sanction, but the third respondent without considering all the relevant materials, granted sanction for lessor offence.
4.Under the above circumstances, without going into the merits of the case, the petitioner is directed to approach the third respondent/Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai-6 and place all the materials available with him, for getting necessary sanction and the third respondent/Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai-6 is directed to consider the same and issue proper sanction order, as per Law.
The petitioner is directed to place all the materials before the third respondent within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.

Thereafter, third respondent/Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration,
Chennai-6 is to pass order in accordance with law within a period of six weeks.
